title: Account settings on the live site

brief.body: You'll use our website to do a few everyday things with your account, and tell us how it went. There are no right or wrong answers: we are testing the website, not you. About 20 minutes.

consent.heading: Before you begin
consent.text:
We record your answers, how long each task takes, notes the researcher makes while you work, and anything you type. You are identified only by a code, never your name. Any call recording is kept by the call software, not this tool.

Your answers are used only for this study and deleted 90 days after it ends. You can stop at any time.

items.label: I've read how my answers will be used

hypotheses.statement: Customers can change their contact details without help.
Customers can find and understand their notification settings.

tasks.title: Change your phone number
tasks.scenario: You've got a new phone number. Change it on your account.

questions.prompt: Did you manage to do it?

tasks.title: Turn off marketing emails
tasks.scenario: You get too many offers by email. Stop them, but keep emails about your orders.

questions.prompt: Did you manage to do it?

tasks.title: How you keep track of orders
tasks.scenario: Tell me how you usually keep track of an order once you have placed it.

closing.prompt: What one thing would make your account easier to manage?

thanks.heading: Thank you
thanks.body: That's everything. Thank you for your time.
